name: ShowDownloadsInsecureWarningsEnabled
description:
Enables warnings when potentially dangerous content is downloaded over HTTP.

If you enable or don't configure this policy, when a user tries to download potentially dangerous content from an HTTP site, the user will receive a UI warning, such as "Insecure download blocked." The user will still have an option to proceed and download the item.

If you disable this policy, the warnings for insecure downloads will be suppressed.

name: DefaultDownloadDirectory_recommended
displayName: Set default download directory (users can override)
description:
This policy sets the default directory that Microsoft Edge uses to download files. Users can change the directory through browser settings.

If you don't configure this policy, Microsoft Edge uses the platform-specific default download directory.

This policy has no effect if the DownloadDirectory policy is set.

For a list of supported variables, see https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/deployedge/edge-learnmore-create-user-directory-vars .
